methods.name: Stage-Progression
methods.rationale: Applies typical Seed → next-stage step-up multiplier (2.5x) to $2M total raised proxy.

data.narrative:
ADMARES is a seed-stage housing and construction technology company founded by Mikael Hedberg. The valuation analysis draws on a private peer set of five comparable companies operating in the same sector: BotBuilt, Apis Cor, Unlimited Industries, Ground Control Development, and Hedral. No public comparables are available in this subsector, limiting triangulation to private market methodology.

The stage-progression method was the applicable valuation technique given available data. Using total capital raised of $1.78M as a proxy for seed-stage value and applying a 2.5x multiplier typical of seed-to-next-stage progression, the analysis derives an implied valuation of $4.45M. This represents the median point in the triangulated range.

The analysis supports a valuation band of $4M to $5M, with $4.45M as the central estimate. The low end reflects conservative application of stage-progression methodology; the high end incorporates modest upside. Key uncertainties include the absence of public market benchmarks, limited visibility into the comparables' financial performance and growth trajectories, and reliance on a single valuation method. Additional data on revenue, burn rate, and product-market traction would strengthen the analysis and narrow the valuation range. The range should be treated as preliminary pending deeper diligence into unit economics and market positioning relative to the peer set.
